failure_mode: HTTP 404 on every path, including the API root
root_cause: NCI withdrew the Resources for Researchers API. /r4r/v1/resources, /r4r/v2/resources and /r4r/ itself all answer 404, and so does the cancer.gov page that documented it (https://www.cancer.gov/research/infrastructure/cancer-research-resources). The host is not the problem: https://webapis.cancer.gov/ answers 200, and the sibling NCI Drug Dictionary tools on https://webapis.cancer.gov/drugdictionary/v1/ still pass, so only this dataset's API was removed.
workaround: No ToolUniverse tool replaces it: NCI publishes no successor JSON API for this catalogue. The adjacent NCI data that is still served is the Drug Dictionary, used by NCI_get_drug_by_name and NCI_expand_drugs_by_letter. For trials, clinicaltrialsapi.cancer.gov is live but now requires an API key (it answers 401 without one), and ClinicalTrials.gov's own API remains open and is covered by the clinicaltrials_gov tools.
investigation_notes: Surfaced by the weekly tool health check as 'NCI_search_cancer_resources API error'; the status code in the payload was 404 and the body an HTML error page.
Three consecutive calls with the shipped examples returned 404 (2026-10-03).
Control: https://webapis.cancer.gov/ returns 200, so the host is up and the path is gone.
The documentation page on cancer.gov also 404s, so this is a withdrawal rather than a move.
